items.question: Our team habit is looser than the departmental procedure. Which one wins?
items.answer: The departmental procedure wins over a team habit, and S17 wins where the local procedure is silent or weaker. A local rule may be stricter. It may not weaken a Shall.

items.question: A line says Should. Can we ignore it because the audit sample did not ask?
items.answer: No. Should means implement whenever possible. An auditor not asking this year is not a reason to drop it. If you defer it, write why.

items.question: Is a tick in this hub proof that our system complies?
items.answer: No. A tick is an optional note in one browser. It is not evidence, not a sign-off, and not a classification.
